info.name: Process Street Public Attachments Tasks API
List all approvals in a workflow run

params.name: workflowRunId
params.description: The ID of the Workflow Run

Opaque pagination cursor. Take this value from the previous response's `links[]` entry whose `name`
is `"next"` (typically just follow that link's `href` instead of reading this value).
Omit on the first page. If the previous response had no `next` link, there are no more pages.

items.docs:
Returns a list of approved or rejected approvals for a workflow run. It will not return pending approvals
that have not yet been acted upon.
The approvals are returned 20 at a time, sorted in task order.
You must use the links section to get the next 20 results.

params.name: workflowRunId
params.description: The ID of the Workflow Run

items.docs:
The approvalTaskId is the ID of the approval task and the subjectTaskId is the ID of the task being approved or rejected. If you don't include a subject task, all pending subject tasks of the approval task will be approved or rejected.

A PUT request replaces all values, so all fields must be supplied in each request. To not have a comment, you may send a null value or omit the field. See the examples for more.
